summary: First full pass on the Smady n8n/PostgreSQL integration. Backend: 34 pytest cases across auth (JWT httpOnly cookies, signup/login/me/refresh/logout, bcrypt hash format, brute force), ICP, Leads, Outreach, Dashboard and multi-user data isolation - 33 passed (97%). n8n callback pipelines (ICP, Leads, Outreach) were fully simulated with the X-Callback-Secret header and verified end-to-end against Postgres. Frontend: Playwright covered unauth route guard, login (wrong + right password), signup, session persistence on reload, logout, ICP/Leads/Outreach 'webhook_not_configured' graceful handling, lead upload persistence, send-to-outreach status change, and dashboard real-data rendering - all core flows work. One real backend security bug (brute-force lockout bypassable) and several display/logic bugs on the dashboard/outreach UI found.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout is effectively bypassable. auth_router builds identifier = f"{request.client.host}:{email}" but behind the k8s ingress request.client.host is the rotating ingress pod IP (observed 10.208.134.74 AND 10.208.134.75 for the same client). Attempts are therefore split across multiple identifier rows, so 5 consecutive wrong passwords return 401,401,401,401,401,401 (never 429). Verified in DB: two rows for the same email with attempts=4 and attempts=2. It only locks after ~10 attempts and even then 401s still slip through (observed sequence 401x9,429,429,429,401,429). Fix: derive the client IP from X-Forwarded-For (left-most) or key the counter on email only (optionally email + real IP).

minor.issue: openRate/replyRate/bounceRate use total = sent+opened+replied+bounced as the denominator instead of the number of emails sent. With 2 sent / 1 opened / 1 replied / 1 bounced the UI shows Open 20%, Reply 20%, Bounce 20% (should be 50% each of sent). Rates can also never exceed 100% but are semantically wrong.
Callback marks the campaign status 'Sent' but never sets sent_date, so the Outreach 'Recent Requests' table shows an empty SENT DATE cell for campaigns that were actually delivered.

leadSourceBreakdown returns raw counts, but the frontend DonutChartCard renders them as `{value}%` (see frontend issue). Either return percentages or fix the UI. Also leadsToday/totalLeads/emailsSent 'sparkline' arrays are fake ([0,0,0,0,0,0,value]) rather than real time series.

Endpoint does not accept a file at all - it fabricates N rows named 'Uploaded Contact i' with title/company 'Unknown' and empty email. No real CSV parsing, so 'Upload Leads' cannot import actual data.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to the lifespan context manager. Also unused `func` import in leads_router.py.
Accepts arbitrary id strings and returns 200 even when no row matched (no 404 / affected-row check). Non-UUID ids would raise a DB cast error.

ui_bugs.issue: Legend renders `{d.value}%` but the API now sends raw lead counts. With 7 leads (1 Agent, 6 Uploaded) the card reads 'Agent 1%' / 'Uploaded 6%' instead of 14% / 86%. Leftover from the old mock data which was already percentages.

toast.success('Campaign sent') is fired unconditionally after addCampaign(), so when the webhook is not configured the user sees BOTH 'Campaign sent' and "Outreach webhook isn't configured yet..." while the row status is 'Failed'. Contradictory feedback - only toast success when the returned campaign status is not 'Failed'.

Renders only the first name with no greeting text, so the page title reads just 'Test' / 'QA' next to the plan badge - looks like an unfinished string (e.g. 'Welcome back, Test'). Also still falls back to the hardcoded mock name 'Alex Morgan' when user is null.
Subtitle reads 'vs yesterday' but the backend comparison is this-week vs last-week (7-day buckets). Misleading label.
12 monthly data points are returned but the x-axis only labels Feb..Dec - the 'Jan' tick is missing/clipped.
Uses a native browser <select> (native chevron visible in screenshot) instead of the shadcn Select used elsewhere - inconsistent with the rest of the design system.

issues: Lead Source Breakdown legend shows counts suffixed with '%' (see ui_bugs)
'vs yesterday' copy on week-over-week comparison cards
Leads Growth x-axis missing Jan label
SENT DATE column is blank for every row (never populated for Failed campaigns, and callback does not set it for Sent ones)

action_items: HIGH: Fix brute-force lockout identifier - use X-Forwarded-For left-most IP or key on email only; request.client.host is the rotating ingress pod IP so 5-attempt lockout never triggers.
HIGH: Fix Lead Source Breakdown donut - it prints raw counts with a '%' suffix. Either compute percentages in /api/dashboard/stats or drop the '%' in DonutChartCard.
MEDIUM: Remove the unconditional toast.success('Campaign sent') in Outreach.tsx onSend so a Failed campaign does not also show a success toast.
MEDIUM: /api/outreach/stats - compute open/reply/bounce rate against emails sent, not against total event count.
LOW: Set sent_date in /api/outreach/callback when status becomes Sent so the Outreach table SENT DATE is populated.
LOW: PageHeader greeting is just the first name and falls back to hardcoded 'Alex Morgan'; add real greeting copy and remove the mock fallback.
LOW: Relabel ComparisonCard 'vs yesterday' -> 'vs last week'; fix missing Jan tick on Leads Growth chart.
LOW: /api/leads/upload fabricates placeholder rows and accepts no file - implement real CSV upload/parsing (or make the modal copy explicit that it is a demo import).
LOW: Replace @app.on_event with FastAPI lifespan; remove unused `func` import in leads_router.py; add row-match validation to /api/leads/send-to-outreach.
Create /app/memory/test_credentials.md - it is missing; credentials were only available in the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_router.login: identifier = f"{request.client.host}:{email}" is unsafe behind a proxy/ingress - the counter fragments across proxy IPs and the documented '5 failed attempts -> 429' control does not hold. This is a genuine security regression, not a test artifact.

Cookies are set with secure=True/samesite=none which is correct for the preview HTTPS origin, but there is no local/HTTP fallback - logging in over plain HTTP (local dev) will silently fail to persist the session.
record_failed_attempt uses a plain INSERT on a unique column with no ON CONFLICT - two concurrent failed logins for a new identifier can raise an unhandled IntegrityError (500).
Dashboard sparklines are hardcoded [0,0,0,0,0,0,value] placeholders - they render a fake trend line that always looks 'up'.
DonutChartCard hardcodes a '%' suffix on whatever value it receives - a display contract mismatch introduced when mock percentages were replaced with real counts.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all core flows pass; 6 display/logic UI defects)

seed_data_creation: Signed up throwaway users TEST_signup_*, TEST_lock_*, TEST_iso_*, TEST_iso2_*, qaui<timestamp>@example.com. Added leads via /api/leads/callback (TEST Lead *) and /api/leads/upload (Uploaded Contact *), ICP profiles and campaigns (TEST Campaign *, QA UI Campaign, QA Toast Campaign) for testuser@example.com. login_attempts rows were reset to attempts=0/locked_until=NULL after the brute-force test so no account is locked.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is MISSING. Used credentials from the review request: testuser@example.com / password123. N8N_CALLBACK_SECRET read from /app/backend/.env.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite is /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v). It covers all 20 endpoints incl. simulated n8n callbacks with the X-Callback-Secret header. TestBruteForce::test_wrong_password_then_lockout is the ONLY expected failure until the proxy-IP identifier bug is fixed - after the fix it should go green. IMPORTANT: running that test can lock accounts; clear with `UPDATE smady.login_attempts SET attempts=0, locked_until=NULL;` (psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d smady, password in /app/backend/.env). Note sonner toasts auto-dismiss in ~4s, so poll every ~250ms when asserting toasts in Playwright instead of a single 6s wait. Verified working: signup/login/logout/route-guard/session-persistence, webhook_not_configured toasts on ICP+Leads+Campaign, lead upload persistence across reload, send-to-outreach status flip to Contacted, dashboard real Postgres data (Total Leads matches DB, no 3260 mock), and per-user data isolation.
rca_of_the_issue: Brute-force lockout: the login route keys its attempt counter on request.client.host, which behind the Kubernetes ingress is the ingress pod's IP, and that IP rotates across pods for consecutive requests from the same client. Each identifier row therefore accumulates only a fraction of the attempts, so the attempts>=5 threshold that sets locked_until is not reached after 5 real failures (reproduced: 6 wrong passwords -> six 401s; DB showed the same email split into rows with attempts=4 and attempts=2). Mitigation: parse the left-most X-Forwarded-For value for the true client IP, or key the counter on the email address alone.
